name: Create Comment
description: Create a comment on a share or user generated content post. [See the docs here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/shares/network-update-social-actions#create-comment)

configurable_props.name: urnToComment
configurable_props.label: Urn to comment
configurable_props.description: The share or user generated content post where the comment will be made.

configurable_props.name: actor
configurable_props.label: Actor
configurable_props.description: Entity which is authoring the comment, must be a person or an organization URN.

configurable_props.name: message
configurable_props.label: Message
configurable_props.description: Text of the comment. May contain attributes such as links to people and organizations.

configurable_props.name: content
configurable_props.label: Content
configurable_props.description: Array of a media content entities.

configurable_props.name: parentComment
configurable_props.label: Parent Comment
configurable_props.description: For nested comments, this is the urn of the parent comment. This is not available for first-level comments.
